name: sampling_procedure
title: Sampling procedures
description: Sampling procedures. DDIC must verify QDSV keys and the selected sampling/valuation fields. A procedure also depends on sample size rules, sampling schemes, dynamic modification and valuation settings; export those through the native QM configuration interface and verify the complete dependency set. Sampling procedure headers alone are not a complete statistical sampling scheme.
